facts.text: Duropedic Airboost 6.8 Arctic Ice Mattress | 1 lakh+ Airknit fibres with latex and adjustable firmness | 100 nights trial
Selected option: Queen | 78 x 60 (198 cm x 152 cm) | 8 (20.3 cm).
The product title states that it has Airknit fibres with latex.
“Airboost is Duroflex's proprietary open-matrix mattress technology made from over one lakh independently responsive fibres, designed to improve airflow, movement response and postural support.”
“The mattress features a 6-inch Airboost layer combined with latex for responsive support, superior breathability, and pressure relief while keeping you cool throughout the night.”
“The duo comfort flippable topper features Airboost Lite on one side for firm, adaptive support and Neo-Latex on the other side for medium firm, responsive comfort.”
“This Airboost mattress features a reversible latex topper with firm support on one side and medium firm on the other.”
“Simply flip the mattress to switch between firmness levels.”
“The zipper cover makes it easy to remove and identify each side.”
“The zipper cover is machine washable but softer wash settings should be used to increase durability.”
“Airboost mattresses come with a long-term manufacturer warranty that covers manufacturing defects and material issues under normal use conditions.”

“Warranty duration varies from 7-10 years depending on the variant.” This is general Airboost range wording and does not establish the selected variant’s duration; the selected page also displays a 10-year warranty banner.

“This Airboost mattresses comes with a 100 day sleep trial period that allows you to experience the mattress at home before making a final decision.” The selected page title instead says “100 nights trial”; the trial unit is unresolved.
